title: Where does Bills QB Josh Allen sit in 2026 NFL MVP odds entering Week 7?

Where is Bills QB Josh Allen in 2026 NFL MVP odds entering Week 7? Schedule NFL News Draft Fantasy Odds Betting Newsletter BILLS Where does Bills QB Josh Allen sit in 2026 NFL MVP odds entering Week 7?
 Here's the latest look at Bills QB Josh Allen's odds to win the 2026 NFL MVP Award.
 Nick Wojton USA TODAY Oct. 25, 2026, 1:56 p.m. ET Buffalo Bills quarterback Josh Allen will just be doing his best to stay healthy this weekend.
 The Bills (5-1) are on their bye in Week 7. There is no game for Allen to personally improve his chances of winning the 2026 NFL MVP Award.
 But there are plenty of other contenders for the honor that are on the field playing, so these are still worth knowing and watching for this weekend.
 According to Bet MGM, here are the latest 2026 NFL MVP winner odds entering Week 7:
